description: The chart illustrates a performance comparison of three different models across various evaluation datasets and their average. The horizontal axis contains the categorical datasets, ordered from left to right as PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, without an explicit overarching axis label. The vertical axis represents the numerical score; however, it lacks an explicit axis line, label, tick marks, or grid lines. Instead, the values are indicated by numerical annotations placed directly above each bar, with a linear scale implied by the bar heights ranging from 0.42 to 1.00. The chart features grouped vertical bars, with each category containing a cluster of three bars arranged side-by-side. According to the legend at the bottom, the dark purple bars represent "RedWhale (our)", the teal bars represent "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and the light grey bars represent "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)". Every bar is annotated with its exact value. Across all categories, the light grey "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)" bars are consistently the tallest, each annotated with a value of 1.00. The dark purple "RedWhale (our)" bars are consistently the shortest in each group, with the lowest overall value occurring in the PT-EVAL category at 0.42. The teal "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0" bars fall in between, ranging from 0.46 in PT-EVAL to 0.74 in KoBEST-CP. The final category, AVG, displays values of 0.57 for RedWhale, 0.61 for EEVE, and 1.00 for SOLAR. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted by value, but the bars within each group follow a consistent order, and visual emphasis is provided by the numerical annotations above every bar.
